title: Special types of piles.
officialText:
The use of types of piles not specifically mentioned herein is permitted, subject to the approval of
the commissioner, upon the submission of acceptable test data, calculations and other information relating to the structural
properties and load capacity of such piles. The allowable stresses shall not in any case exceed the limitations specified herein.
